summary: This YAML file defines a Docker Compose configuration for a Joomla application with two services: a web application container and a database container. Both containers use a template variable %%name=kingsbridge%% that gets substituted with 'kingsbridge' to create their container names, making it easy to redeploy the same setup with different names.

explanations.2: This sets a variable named 'name' with a default value of 'kingsbridge'. The %% syntax indicates this is a template variable that can be overridden when the file is processed.
explanations.6: The container_name uses the template variable from line 2, so this container will be named 'kingsbridge-app'. This gets substituted when Docker Compose runs.
explanations.11: Similarly, this database container will be named 'kingsbridge-db' using the same template variable, keeping the naming consistent across all containers.
